title: Jokes about Miles Davis: genetics and electronics
summary: Gil recalls two old men's explanations for Miles's sound, one genetics and one electronics, at Beef Steak Charlie's.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And it's not been done because they are especially inclined that way. They've been leaned on. We've all benn leaned on that way regardless of whether genetics are involved and you've done the best you can. For examples, Miles, it's funny you know, I had two, two funny comments about those two old men. One was a father, somebody asked his father asked how they accounted for Miles Davis being such a great artist. So I said, genetics. (LAUGHTER).
And I was in a bar, musicians used to hang out

at (Beef Steak Charlie's on 50th Street at one time in the '50s and somebody asked another old man this thing was bothering him. 'How do you account for the way Miles Davis sounds on his records?' And the man said, 'electronics.' (LAUGHTER).
So those two ( ?) explanations and neither one of them are true. (LAUGHTER).
